quote: The print arrived flat, signed and a shade warmer than it looked on screen, which is exactly what I wanted. It has changed the whole end of the room.
author: Sarah Mitchell

quote: I have bought a lot of prints. This is the first one where I could feel the ink standing off the paper, and the first where somebody wrote to tell me which day it was pulled.
author: Daniel Carter

quote: The vase has a thumbprint near the foot where it was lifted off the wheel. My partner spotted it within a minute and has mentioned it to every visitor since.
author: Michael Thompson

quote: They emailed a photograph of the lettering before framing it and caught a spelling I had given them wrong. Small thing. It is why I have ordered three more.
author: Sophia Martinez
